verdict.rationale: Solid's ability to author standalone web components (solid-gh-7), use real DOM elements inspectable via devtools (solid-gh-5), and integrate with native JS libraries (solid-gh-8) implies feasibility of embedding Solid in small page sections, and Asciinema's use as 'a small UI library' within an app (solid-comm-1) supports partial adoption. However, no direct documentation or user testimony explicitly describes a scale-up migration path from a widget to a full app.
